comparison.objective: Replace an air-conditioner mesh filter; candidate screens a parts/media mixture.
comparison.physical_skill: Remove and hook-seat a flexible panel behind retainers versus manipulate an active separating screen.
comparison.success_condition: Old filter removed, clean filter fitted, cover shut versus media passed while washers remain.
comparison.reason: A filter-shaped object does not make this a screening task; the filter is installed, not used to separate a batch.
